title: Quests show how far you have to go
summary:
Quest progress is visible, private models are easier to set up, and the model catalog and key permissions make more sense.

Measurable Quests now show progress bars and current/target values, including for Pollen top-ups, external app users, and GitHub account age. Quest-code redemption was removed; claimable Bonus rewards remain in the regular Quest flow.

Any authenticated account can now fetch upstream model IDs and test an endpoint before registering a private model, without publisher approval. The publisher request form also covers public managed agents, public community models, or both. Image-model CLI guidance now explains testing, image-edit inputs, and how pricing depends on visibility; a community-contributed fix tidied the endpoint toggle dialog.

The models catalog now presents IDs, capabilities, access labels, rate limits, and pricing more consistently across desktop and mobile, with better touch and keyboard controls. Meadows, a community playground for text, image, video, and audio models, joined the app catalog, and the README news was refreshed. Model Monitor's favorites and persistent filter selections were removed; its scope and type filters remain.

highlights.title: See your Quest progress
highlights.text: Measurable Quests now show a progress bar and current/target values, so you can see how close you are to a Pollen top-up, app-user, or GitHub account-age goal.

highlights.title: Test private model endpoints
highlights.text: In My Models, authenticated accounts can fetch a provider's model IDs and test an upstream endpoint before registering a private model. Public publishing still requires approval.

highlights.title: Request agent publishing access
highlights.text: The publisher request form now lets you ask to publish public managed agents, public community models, or both. Private agents do not need publishing approval.

highlights.title: A clearer models catalog
highlights.text: Compare model capabilities, access labels, rate limits, and pricing in redesigned desktop and mobile cards, with clearer details controls on mobile. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
